ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's Feeding Our Future Fraud Scandal on Local Communities
ideas.description: Investigate how the fraud scandal affected local communities and what measures are being taken to prevent similar incidents in the future.
questions: How did the fraud affect local communities?
What measures are being taken to prevent similar incidents?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the human impact of the fraud and the importance of effective oversight and management in preventing similar incidents.
